name: Improper Validation of Integrity Check Value
principle: The product uses an integrity or authentication result without validating that the result is valid for the object and operation being consumed.
detection_signals: A signature, MAC, checksum, or verification result is computed but a consumer proceeds without checking its success value
A verification result is overwritten, inverted, or checked for the wrong object before a sensitive state transition or use
Parsed or received integrity metadata is consumed as trusted state before its authenticity and scope are established
negative_signals: The verification result is checked on every path before the authenticated object is used
Failure, exception, and state-transition paths reject the object and do not continue with the unchecked value
The check binds the verified result to the same object, algorithm, and operation that the consumer uses
false_defense_traps: Calling a verification API without checking its return value
Checking only that a signature or checksum field is present
Validating one object and consuming a different alias or stale state
verification_focus: Is the integrity result for this exact object checked and enforced before any security-sensitive consumer or state transition?
patch_principle: Fail closed when integrity verification fails or is unavailable
Bind verification results to the exact object and operation being consumed
